Name: Mistria Valley
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Marnie has reached out to a fellow farmer, a man named Hayden, who agreed to supply Marnie and Stardew Valley with some animals!

This mod includes 7 new barn animals, all in 11 color varieties:
-Cows - produce Mistria Milk and Golden Mistria Milk, which can be turned into cheese via the cheese press, or butter via the keg
-Bulls - produce regular and golden bull horns
-Ewes - produces wool and golden wool, which can be spun on the loom into cloth
-Rams - produces wool and golden wool which can be spun on the loom into cloth
-Capybaras - produces bristles and golden bristles
-Alpacas - produces wool that can be spun on the loom into cloth
-Horses - produces horse hair and golden horse hair

And 5 new coops animals, also in 11 color varieties:
-Chicken Hens (produces chicken eggs and golden chicken eggs)
-Chicken Roosters (produce feathers and golden feathers)
-Ducks Hens (produces duck eggs and gold duck eggs)
-Duck Drakes (produces feathers and gold feathers)
-Rabbits (produce wool and gold wool)

FUTURE PLANS: 
-Mayos for the eggs
-Possibly different colors of wools and feathers, and maybe crafts for some of the raw materials
-Some of the animation translation from Mistria to SDV are a little choppy right now (spritesheets had to be built, colored, and ratioed from scratch and may be a bit sloppy) I will try to clean those up a bit more in the future
-Maaaaybe some cooking recipes?
-I'd like to figure out making the capybaras swim at some point haha

Enjoy!
